then.text: {greeting} The display's up: Withens, the Bull and the vault. The Bells would be proud. Well, Charlotte would. Emily would pretend not to care.
Withens, the Black Bull and the family vault. You've walked the whole story: the moor that made the books, the brother who lost his way, and the grave that keeps them all.
Take this. It's a copy of Keeper's collar. Emily's dog was the most loyal soul in Haworth.

else.text: Now the church. Ask the verger about the family vault, and who isn't in it.
Next, the Black Bull at the top of Main Street. The landlord knows Branwell's story better than anyone.
First, Top Withens, out on the moor along the Brontë Way. Go and stand where Emily stood. And mind the moody chap.
{greeting} Welcome to the Parsonage. Three sisters wrote some of the greatest novels in English at that table. In a damp house. Next to a graveyard. With a brother in the pub.
I'm building a little trail for visitors. Will you walk it for me first? Top Withens on the moor, the Black Bull, and the family vault in the church.
Come back and tell me what you learn. Bring your own umbrella. Haworth never lends one.
